lines: Riley Chen
+1 (555) 010-9054 | riley.chen@example.com | example.com/in/rchen
EDUCATION
Harbor State University | B.B.A. in Finance | Metro City, USA | Sep 2016 - May 2020
EXPERIENCE
Lakeside Golf Club | Caddie | Metro City, USA | Aug 2025 - Present
- Caddied about 5 rounds a week, carrying bags and reading greens for members.
- Helped the pro shop run the weekend junior tournament.
Stonebridge Manufacturing | Financial Analyst | Metro City, USA | Jan 2023 - Jun 2025
- Improved close efficiency by 40% by automating reconciliations and intercompany eliminations.
- Modeled the capital plan for 12 plant projects in a shared NPV template, so every request used the same discount rate and payback rules.
- Wrote the variance commentary for the monthly board pack, explaining each line more than 5% off budget.
- Valued the acquisition target by discounting its free cash flow to equity at the company's weighted average cost of capital.
- Reported a 45% group EBITDA margin by adding the EBITDA margins of the three business units.
- Built the rolling 18-month cash-flow forecast for a USD 600M manufacturer, keeping monthly forecast error under 4% and letting treasury pay down USD 40M of revolver debt early.
Crescent Bank | Credit Analyst | Metro City, USA | Jul 2020 - Dec 2022
- Underwrote 60 small-business loans worth USD 45M, and none of the approved loans defaulted in their first two years.
- Reviewed 3 years of declined applications; my findings changed two ratio thresholds and raised approvals from 41% to 48% with no rise in early defaults.
- Writes the covenant-monitoring checklist for the portfolio, cutting missed covenant tests from 7 to 1 a year.
- Built a spreading template for borrower financials that cut each credit memo from 6 hours to 3.
PROJECTS
Regional Utility Valuation | Independent Project | Excel | Nov 2024 - Present
- Valued a listed regional utility with a 10-year DCF and a comparable-company check, landing within 6% of the market price.
- Tested the valuation's sensitivity: a 1-point change in the discount rate moved the share value from USD 52 to USD 44.
- Shared the model and a two-page note with the university investment club, which used it in its spring pitch.
Student Investment Fund | Analyst, Team of 6 | Excel | Sep 2018 - May 2019
- Supported the FP&A team with financial reporting and analysis.
- Rebuilt the fund's performance report to show returns against its benchmark, which the committee used at every meeting.
- Built an 18-month cash forecast for a USD 600M business, holding error to about 4% and freeing USD 40M to repay debt early.
SKILLS
Tools: Excel, Bloomberg Terminal
Methods: financial modeling, DCF valuation, forecasting, credit analysis

items.says: Verify that the professional profile URL is complete and works.
Decide whether the caddie role needs to be included.
items.because: It may be useful for showing current employment but may not earn space on a finance résumé.

items.says: Prioritize a responsibility or result more relevant to the target roles.
items.because: Carrying bags and reading greens may not help much for a finance application.

items.says: Specify what you did for the junior tournament and what your contribution was.
items.because: The bullet is brief and may not earn space on a finance résumé without meaningful scope or a substantiated outcome.

items.says: Define the 40% close-efficiency measure and its before-and-after comparison.
items.because: It is unclear what became 40% better.

items.says: Make the automation’s scope and your contribution precise.
Clarify your role in developing or implementing the NPV template.
Clarify whether the template was adopted across all 12 projects or changed the process or decisions.
items.because: The wording explains why it mattered but not whether it changed anything.

items.says: Clarify what “more than 5% off budget” measures and whether you covered every line above that threshold.
items.because: The bullet’s scope should accurately reflect your responsibility for the commentary.

items.says: The acquisition valuation mismatches FCFE with WACC.
items.because: FCFE is generally discounted at the cost of equity, while WACC is generally used with free cash flow to the firm.

items.says: Adding three business-unit EBITDA margins does not produce a group EBITDA margin.
items.because: A consolidated margin must be calculated correctly from the underlying data.

items.says: Define forecast error and its measurement period.
items.because: The metric needs to be easier to verify.

items.says: Describe the USD 40M repayment as an outcome the forecast enabled, not one solely attributable to you.
The cash-forecast achievement is duplicated under the Student Investment Fund.
items.because: The same 18-month forecast, roughly 4% error and USD 40M repayment appear in both places.

items.says: Clarify whether USD 45M is the value of loans underwritten or loans approved.
Define a sufficiently seasoned cohort for the two-year no-default claim.
items.because: The claim could be misleading if some loans had not completed two years.

items.says: Avoid implying that underwriting alone caused the no-default result.
Clarify the period or cohort of declined applications reviewed.
Clarify whether the approval-rate increase was observed after the threshold changes.
Support the no-rise-in-early-defaults claim with a comparison period and definition.
“Writes” is in the wrong tense.
items.because: The Crescent Bank role ended in 2022.

items.says: Clarify the time period behind the reduction in missed covenant tests.
Represent the checklist’s contribution to that reduction accurately.
Clarify what “each credit memo” covers and how the time reduction was measured.
Clarify the independent project’s relationship to the university investment club.
items.because: The project is called independent, but a later bullet says the club used it.

items.says: Ensure the ongoing dates reflect actual ongoing work.
items.because: The project is marked as continuing to the present.

items.says: Specify the date or period of the market-price comparison and explain its assumptions.
items.because: Market price is time-sensitive.

items.says: Do not present being within 6% of market price as sufficient evidence of valuation accuracy.
items.because: That comparison is not, by itself, evidence of accuracy.

items.says: Clarify that the discount-rate change is in percentage points and state its direction.
items.because: The sensitivity result is otherwise hard to interpret.

items.says: Explain what the USD 52 and USD 44 share values represent.
items.because: That would make the sensitivity result easier to interpret.

items.says: Identify the relevant spring period.
Clarify whether the club used the model, the note or both.
Clarify the FP&A group’s identity and its fit with a student investment fund.
items.because: As written, the bullet could be read as corporate FP&A work.

items.says: Clarify what your contribution to the FP&A work was.
Clarify which returns or benchmark the performance report covered, if that helps show its scope.
The cash-forecast achievement appears to duplicate the Stonebridge accomplishment.
items.because: Its 18-month forecast, roughly 4% error and USD 40M repayment are nearly identical, and the wording does not distinguish the settings.

items.says: Substantiate the Bloomberg Terminal skill with meaningful working experience.
items.because: No experience or project example shows its use.
